summary: This Wikipedia article describes the Major League Baseball rivalry between the Los Angeles Dodgers and the New York Yankees. It traces the rivalry's origins to the teams' shared New York City roots and its continuation after the Dodgers moved to Los Angeles, and notes that the teams have met 11 times in the World Series. It also covers their regular-season and post-season meeting statistics, including the record, largest victories, win streaks, and series results.
one_line: Overview and statistics of the Major League Baseball rivalry between the Los Angeles Dodgers and New York Yankees.
key_facts: The Los Angeles Dodgers are a member club of the National League West division, and the New York Yankees are a member club of the American League East division.
The Dodgers and Yankees have met 11 times in the World Series, more than any other pair of teams from the American and National Leagues.
The rivalry's initial significance came from the two teams' proximity in New York City, when the Dodgers initially played in Brooklyn.
After the Dodgers moved to Los Angeles in 1958, the rivalry kept its significance as the two teams represented the dominant cities on each coast of the United States.
Since the 1980s, the Dodgers and Yankees have represented the two largest cities in the United States.
The Dodgers lead the regular season series 7-6.
The Yankees and Dodgers have not met in the World Series since 1981.
The two teams first met on October 1, 1941, and first met in a non-exhibition game in 2004 during a 3-game interleague series.
The teams have met 78 times in total: 65 World Series meetings and 13 regular season meetings.
The largest victory was 12-2 for the Yankees in the 1978 World Series on October 15, 1978.
The largest regular season victory was 6-0 for the Dodgers on June 19, 2013.
The Dodgers' longest win streak was 2 games (June 19, 2013 to July 30, 2013), and the Yankees' longest win streak was also 2 games (June 27, 2010 to June 19, 2013).
The Dodgers were on a 1-game win streak at the time of the article's statistics.
The Dodgers defeated the Yankees in the 1955 World Series 4-3, in the 1963 World Series 4-0, and in the 1981 World Series 4-2.
The Yankees defeated the Dodgers in the 1941, 1947, 1949, 1952, 1953, 1956, 1977 and 1978 World Series.
